summary: This standards-track document extends how OSPFv3 Link State Advertisements are formatted, going beyond the fixed format of RFC 5340. Without it, attributes of links and IPv6 prefixes have to be advertised in separate LSAs and matched up. The extension makes OSPFv3 easier to extend.

eli5.summary: A form with fixed boxes has no room for new facts. This gives OSPFv3 a roomier form so new details can be added neatly.

questions: what is the ospfv3 extended lsa format
